summary: Independent cold screening of main.tex and references.bib for arXiv found zero blockers across AI authorship, Google Antigravity for Science workflow and acknowledgment disclosures, retrospective claim grounding, ethics/code/data availability statements, and citation integrity. All 31 bibliography entries and 3 embedded figure PDFs align with manuscript tables and claims, and clinical/financial experiments are consistently framed as retrospective masked-column simulations on public de-identified datasets.

warnings.detail: Abstract states 'Holm p <= 0.018 for AUPRC and (alpha,delta)-certified Neyman-Pearson sensitivity' (three-decimal rounding), whereas Section 3.2 (L284) reports the exact NP sensitivity ceiling as 0.01807 (strictly <= 0.0181).

LightGBM, imbalanced-learn, and OpenML are properly cited; consider optionally adding a scikit-learn citation (Pedregosa et al., 2011) for Platt logistic calibration/k-NN diagnostics and listing the UCI Scania APS ID (421) plus the remaining 7 OpenML dataset IDs in Data and Code Availability.
Minor duplication between Section 2.6 (Ethics Statement) and the unnumbered Institutional Review Board and Informed Consent Statement section, both stating the 45 CFR 46.104(d)(4) exemption.
